prompts.archerHit: Production 2D fantasy RPG VFX sprite sheet, true transparent RGBA background. Exactly FOUR columns TWO rows, eight equal square cells, sequential frames reading order. ONE short impact animation, fixed contact point at each cell center. No text, no grid, no weapon objects, no people, generous transparent cell margins. Polished luminous hand painted particle effect, clean readable silhouette, compact concentrated power, NOT a flower, NOT a shuriken, NOT a decorative magic circle. Stages: frame1 tiny hot contact seed; frame2 bright tight flash; frame3 peak directional impact; frame4 explosive spread; frame5 widening broken shock front; frame6 fragment streaks fading; frame7 few dissolving fragments; frame8 tiny fading embers. Keep brightest impact at center, progression coherent and last frames smaller/fainter. LIGHT ARROW CONTACT: ivory white pierced core, antique gold shards and a few teal luminous feather shaped fragments swept toward RIGHT, oval compressed pressure wave, crisp spearhead flash with short tapered splinters. Elven archer aesthetic, beautiful gold/white/teal light, subtle smoky dust. Much fewer fragments than a full explosion. Transparent background.
